name: username-input
title: Username Input
description: Username field that reads back the exact stored handle, blocks reserved words even in disguise (adm1n) and case-only duplicates, flags lookalikes of existing names with a UTS #39-style skeleton, and checks availability after a pause with free alternatives.

meta.summary: Reads back the exact handle that will be registered and blocks reserved words, case-only duplicates and lookalikes of existing names.
meta.server: Enforce uniqueness on the normalised, skeleton form of the handle with a database constraint.
catches: Reserved and staff words, including digit swaps (adm1n)
limits: Skeleton folding covers common confusables, not the full UTS #39 data
Availability depends on your checkAvailability; race conditions remain until the server reserves the name
a11y: Visible <label>; aria-invalid on blocking issues and status via aria-describedby
Status in a polite live region; blocking errors use role=alert
